```{r}

# Load and clean
rats <- read_csv(
  "Rat_sightings.csv",
  na = c("", "NA"),
  col_types = cols(
    `Incident Zip` = col_character(),
    .default = col_guess()
  )
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  distinct(unique_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert dates
    created_date = mdy_hms(created_date),
    closed_date = mdy_hms(closed_date),

    # Standardize text
    borough = str_to_title(str_trim(borough)),
    location_type = str_squish(location_type),
    descriptor = str_squish(descriptor),

    # Extract useful time variables
    year = year(created_date),
    month = month(created_date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
    month_num = month(created_date)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(created_date))

# Check cleaned data
glimpse(rats)
summary(rats)
```
```{r}

# Missing values
colSums(is.na(rats))

# Borough counts
rats %>%
  count(borough, sort = TRUE)

# Years represented
rats %>%
  count(year, sort = TRUE)

# Location types
rats %>%
  count(location_type, sort = TRUE)

# Date range
range(rats$created_date, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}

monthly_rats <- rats %>%
  filter(
    borough %in% c(
      "Manhattan", "Brooklyn", "Queens",
      "Bronx", "Staten Island"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(borough, year, month_num) %>%
  summarize(
    sightings = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(
      paste(year, month_num, "01", sep = "-")
    )
  )

# View the summary
view(monthly_rats)
```

```{r}

ggplot(
  monthly_rats,
  aes(
    x = date,
    y = sightings,
    color = borough
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date("2023-04-01"),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Rat Sightings by Borough",
    subtitle = "NYC 311 complaints, with April 2023 marked",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of sightings",
    color = "Borough"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
rats %>%
  filter(
    borough == "Brooklyn",
    year %in% c(2019, 2020)
  ) %>%
  count(year, month_num, month) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month_num, y = n, color = factor(year), group = year)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:12,
    labels = month.abb
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Brooklyn Rat Sightings by Month",
    subtitle = "2019 vs. 2020",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of Rat Sightings",
    color = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
